# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We release patches for security vulnerabilities. Which versions are eligible for receiving such patches depends on the CVSS v3.0 Rating:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report (suspected) security vulnerabilities by **[opening a security advisory](https://github.com/ayushgupta0202/vanish-ai/security/advisories/new)** or emailing the maintainers. You will receive a response within 48 hours. If the issue is confirmed, we will release a patch as soon as possible depending on complexity but historically within a few days.

### Reporting Process

1. **Create Security Advisory** at https://github.com/ayushgupta0202/vanish-ai/security/advisories/new
   OR **Email** the maintainers via GitHub
2. **Include**:
   - Description of the vulnerability
   - Steps to reproduce
   - Potential impact
   - Suggested fix (if any)
3. **Wait** for acknowledgment (within 48 hours)
4. **Do not** disclose publicly until we've addressed it

### Security Best Practices

- Keep dependencies up to date
- Review code changes before merging
- Use secure coding practices
- Regular security audits
- Follow principle of least privilege

## Security Features

- ✅ 100% local processing (no data leaves your machine)
- ✅ No external API calls
- ✅ Regular dependency updates via Dependabot
- ✅ Automated security scanning with CodeQL
- ✅ Open source codebase (fully auditable)

## Disclosure Policy

- We will acknowledge receipt of your vulnerability report within 48 hours
- We will provide a detailed response within 7 days
- We will notify you when the vulnerability is fixed
- We will credit you in the release notes (if desired)

Thank you for helping keep Vanish AI and our users safe!
